Adversarial SDK Manual

Use deterministic checkpoints to resume extraction jobs after an interrupted worker restart.

The agent should keep the canonical URL, cleaned Markdown, and structured provenance together.

from agentcrawl import AgentCrawl
crawler = AgentCrawl({"fetcher": "http"})
doc = crawler.scrape("https://example.com/manual")
print(doc.metadata["content_sha256"])
SignalMeaning
checkpointResume marker stored safely
provenanceSource and final URL retained
